sections.description: investigation of serious allegations of misconduct and gross misconduct by police officers

sections.name: Death or Serious Injury Screening
sections.description: mandatory referral and screening of all deaths and serious injuries following police contact

sections.name: Appeals & Review

sections.name: Criminal Investigation of Officers
sections.description: conducting criminal investigations where police officers are suspected of serious offences

sections.name: Learning & Recommendations
sections.description: issuing learning recommendations and practice recommendations to police forces

sections.name: Taser & Use of Force Oversight
sections.description: focused oversight of taser deployment, use of force, and restraint-related incidents

sections.name: Mental Health Crisis Response

sections.name: Annual Statistics & Reporting
sections.description: publication of annual police complaints statistics and thematic reports

sections.description: engaging with communities to maintain public confidence in the police complaints system

sections.name: Governance & Accountability
sections.description: ensuring independence from police forces and accountability to Parliament
